races.name: Human

attributes.application: Flat +2 percentage points added to each selected attribute score (e.g. 35% becomes 37%), not 2% of current score.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.effect: Choose three distinct attributes; each increases by 2 percentage points (e.g. 35% to 37%).

traits.name: Versatile
traits.effect: Gain one additional Skill Talent of choice at character creation.

traits.name: Essence Affinity
traits.effect: Gain 5% additional Essence from all sources.

races.notes: Approved racial mechanics. Attributes themselves are percentages; +2% means +2 percentage points, not multiplicative scaling. Essence bonus remains multiplicative +5%.

lore.habitats: Found in almost any environment across the realms of Mezoria
lore.cultures: Many distinct cultures distributed across the realms; no single universal human culture

races.name: Sylvan

abilities.name: Forest Stride
abilities.description: Ordinary natural forest undergrowth, roots, fallen branches, and vegetation do not impose movement penalties on the Sylvan.
abilities.limitations: Does not bypass magical obstacles, impassable terrain, or physical hazards that genuinely prevent movement.

races.notes: Approved: tall graceful mystical forest race, +3 percentage points Prowess and Presence, 5% Nature Resistance, base movement 6, Forest Stride. Resistance math pending.

races.name: Embergiest

abilities.name: Bare-Handed Forging
abilities.description: Can forge metal using their bare hands, without requiring ordinary external heating tools.
abilities.mechanicsStatus: Limits, crafting checks, and interaction with Crafting talent to be determined

abilities.name: Master of the Forge
abilities.condition: Crafting checks involving metalworking, including weapons, armor, and tools
abilities.description: Gain +10 percentage points to Crafting checks involving metalworking, complementing the Embergiest's existing bare-handed forging ability.

abilities.name: Burning Strikes
abilities.appliesTo: Melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes
abilities.description: Embergiest melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes deal an additional 1 Fire damage per success on the attack.
abilities.limitations: Does not apply to ranged attacks unless otherwise established.

races.notes: Approved: volcanic origin, stone skin with magma glow, expert smiths, +3 percentage points Might and Endurance, movement 4, bare-handed forging, 5% Fire Resistance. Crafting and resistance calculations pending. Balance audit approved: +10% metalworking Crafting and passive +1 Fire damage per success on melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes.

lore.origin: Children of the volcanoes, born from flows of magma
lore.appearance: Skin of stone with the heat of magma glowing from within
lore.craftTradition: All Embergiests are expert smiths, able to forge metal with their bare hands

races.name: Faye

traits.name: Mind Control Resistance
traits.calculation: How percentage applies to mind control effects is pending resistance rules

abilities.name: Low-Altitude Flight
abilities.description: Can hover and fly close to the ground at movement speed 5, while ground movement is 3.
abilities.mechanicsStatus: Rules for airborne movement and interaction with terrain pending

races.notes: Approved lore, +3 percentage points Prowess and Presence, 5% mind control resistance, ground speed 3 and low flight 5 with a five-foot height limit; other mechanics pending.

lore.appearance: Small fairies with luminescent hair and wings
lore.flightMechanism: Wings produce sufficient lift only while within five feet of the ground

movement.flightRestriction: Must remain within five feet of the ground for wing-generated lift; cannot fly higher by this racial ability alone.

races.name: Prismatic

abilities.name: Rune Mastery
abilities.description: Can read and understand runes, identifying their nature and effects.
abilities.limitations: Understanding a rune does not by itself activate, disable, alter, or reproduce its magic; whether exceptional runes require checks is not yet defined.

abilities.name: Arcane Awareness
abilities.description: Sense and examine magical phenomena, including magical energy, active effects, and unusual magical disturbances.
abilities.condition: Checks involving detecting magical energy, investigating magical effects, or identifying magical disturbances
abilities.limitations: Does not automatically identify every spell, reveal all concealed magic, or replace Rune Mastery.

races.notes: Confirmed: crystalline humanoid, internal runic markings, arcane resonance, +3 percentage points Intellect and Endurance, movement 4, 5% Arcane Resistance, innate Rune Mastery. Balance audit approved: Arcane Awareness adds +10 percentage points to appropriate checks involving detection or investigation of magical phenomena.

lore.markings: Runic markings within their crystalline bodies

races.name: Mythrain
races.notes: Twenty approved tribes; each receives individual attribute modifiers, movement, and innate ability; resistance if thematically appropriate. No shared mechanical package established.

lore.identity: Beastfolk of Mezoria, divided into tribes inspired by mammals, reptiles, avians, insectoids and aquatic creatures.

innateAbility.name: Keen Smell
innateAbility.description: Track creatures using scent trails.
innateAbility.condition: Checks made specifically to track by scent

innateAbility.name: Silent Stalker
innateAbility.description: Exceptional stealth when stalking prey, approaching enemies unnoticed, or positioning for an ambush.
innateAbility.condition: Stalking prey, sneaking up on enemies, or positioning for an ambush
innateAbility.limitations: Does not apply to unrelated Stealth checks.

tribes.name: Ursine
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; carrying capacity formula and defensive check mechanics pending

innateAbility.name: Powerful Build
innateAbility.description: Can handle heavy loads and exert exceptional physical force.
innateAbility.condition: Lifting, pushing, or moving heavy objects
innateAbility.additionalBenefit: Can carry heavier loads; exact carrying capacity mechanics pending

additionalInnateAbilities.name: Unyielding Strength
additionalInnateAbilities.description: Exceptional physical stability grants a bonus to defensive checks resisting grapples, shoves, knockdowns, or other forced movement.
additionalInnateAbilities.condition: Defensive checks to resist being grappled, shoved, knocked down, or forcibly moved

innateAbility.name: Surefooted
innateAbility.description: Exceptional balance and footing on steep, narrow, rocky, or uneven terrain.
innateAbility.condition: Maintaining footing, balancing on narrow ledges, or traversing steep rocky terrain

innateAbility.name: Fox's Cunning
innateAbility.description: Use guile and misdirection to deceive others.
innateAbility.condition: Misleading others, creating distractions, or concealing intentions

innateAbility.name: Natural Scales
innateAbility.description: Scaled skin reduces incoming physical damage by 5%.

resistance.timing: Before shield and armor mitigation pools

tribes.name: Serpentine
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; bite damage and poison effects pending

innateAbility.name: Venomous Bite
innateAbility.description: Natural unarmed bite attack capable of inflicting poison.

tribes.name: Crocodilian
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; bite damage and grapple mechanics pending

innateAbility.name: Crushing Jaws
innateAbility.description: Natural bite attack designed to grapple, hold, and restrain enemies.

resistance.timing: Before shield and armor mitigation pools

tribes.name: Chelonian
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; Shell Defense remains stationary and action economy pending

innateAbility.name: Shell Defense
innateAbility.description: Withdraw into the shell to gain additional physical damage resistance.

additionalInnateAbilities.name: Iron Shell
additionalInnateAbilities.description: Stable, sturdy body grants +5 percentage points to defensive checks against being knocked down, shoved, or forcibly moved while standing on solid ground.
additionalInnateAbilities.condition: Defensive checks against knockdown, shoves, or forced movement while standing on solid ground

tribes.name: Aquiline
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; exact gliding distance and action rules pending

movement.glideMechanics: Can control descent, travel horizontally while losing altitude, cannot gain altitude through gliding alone; exact glide distance ratio pending.

innateAbility.name: Eagle Eyes
innateAbility.condition: Spotting distant creatures, movement, or objects
innateAbility.description: Exceptional long-range vision.

movement.glideMechanics: Can control descent and travel horizontally while losing altitude, but cannot gain altitude through gliding; exact distance pending

innateAbility.name: Carrion's Insight
innateAbility.description: Carefully observe and study details, objects, and unfamiliar mechanisms.
innateAbility.condition: Examining objects, searching for hidden details, or studying unfamiliar mechanisms

tribes.name: Strigine
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; detailed glide movement mechanics pending

movement.glideMechanics: Controls descent, can travel horizontally while losing altitude, cannot ascend from gliding alone; detailed distances pending

innateAbility.name: Nocturnal Hunter
innateAbility.description: Exceptional auditory awareness when hunting or detecting creatures.
innateAbility.condition: Checks relying on hearing, including locating creatures in darkness or detecting movement out of sight

innateAbility.name: Predatory Reflexes
innateAbility.condition: Target has not acted in current combat

innateAbility.name: Colony Cooperation
innateAbility.condition: Actively coordinating a physical Athletics task with at least one ally, including moving heavy objects, cooperative climbing, overcoming physical obstacles, and difficult construction tasks
innateAbility.description: Cooperative instincts grant an Athletics bonus when actively coordinating physical tasks with at least one ally.
innateAbility.limitations: No bonus when working alone or on tasks without meaningful physical cooperation

innateAbility.name: Reinforced Carapace
innateAbility.description: While stationary, gain an additional 5% Physical Resistance, bringing total racial Physical Resistance to 10%.
innateAbility.condition: Remains stationary
innateAbility.detailsPending: Interpretation of stationary during combat to be finalized

movement.climbRestrictions: Natural vertical surfaces under ordinary conditions; exact climbing rules pending

innateAbility.name: Wall Crawler
innateAbility.description: Climb vertical natural surfaces at normal movement speed without an Athletics check under ordinary conditions.
innateAbility.exception: Unusual, hazardous, or magically altered surfaces may require checks; details pending.

innateAbility.name: Blood Sense
innateAbility.condition: Detecting or tracking blood in water

innateAbility.name: Chromatic Camouflage
innateAbility.description: Alter skin coloration and patterns to blend into surroundings while remaining stationary.
innateAbility.condition: Remaining stationary and blending into surroundings
innateAbility.limitations: Does not grant invisibility or conceal the character while moving

innateAbility.name: Powerful Leap
innateAbility.condition: Checks involving jumping

tribes.name: Crustacean
tribes.mechanicsStatus: approved; grapple and damage calculations pending

innateAbility.name: Crushing Claws
innateAbility.description: Powerful natural pincers allow grappling and restraining opponents.
innateAbility.condition: Checks to initiate or maintain a grapple

tribeDesignPolicy.attributes: Each tribe receives its own attribute adjustments in percentage points.
tribeDesignPolicy.movement: Each tribe has its own movement speeds and movement types as appropriate.
tribeDesignPolicy.innateAbility: Each tribe has a distinct innate racial ability.
tribeDesignPolicy.resistance: Optional, determined by tribe; do not grant one by default.
tribeDesignPolicy.sharedBonuses: No universal Mythrain mechanical bonuses have been established.
tribeDesignPolicy.startingAvianFlight: No unrestricted powered flight at starting Rank 1; gliding permitted, with progression-based flight powers later

races.name: Draconian
races.notes: Seven terrain-based clans approved. Removed Volcanic, Jungle and Cavern proposals. No clan mechanics approved yet.

lore.identity: Draconian clans are based on terrain and the homelands to which they are adapted.

innateAbility.name: Mountain Climber
innateAbility.condition: Climbing cliffs, rocky slopes, or steep mountainous terrain

innateAbility.name: Desert Survivor
innateAbility.condition: Navigating deserts, locating water or shelter, or enduring harsh arid conditions

innateAbility.name: Woodland Camouflage
innateAbility.condition: Hiding among natural forest vegetation such as trees, bushes, or dense foliage

innateAbility.name: Marsh Walker
innateAbility.condition: Navigating swamps, identifying safe paths through bogs, or avoiding natural marsh hazards

innateAbility.name: Deep Diver
innateAbility.condition: Underwater swimming or diving

innateAbility.name: Frostborn
innateAbility.condition: Surviving extreme cold, navigating snowy terrain, crossing ice safely, or finding shelter during blizzards

innateAbility.name: Fleetfoot
innateAbility.condition: Sustained running, long-distance travel on foot, or maintaining speed across open terrain

sharedRacialAbilities.name: Dragon's Breath
sharedRacialAbilities.targeting: Cone area attack; exact cone dimensions and target resolution pending
sharedRacialAbilities.description: Every Draconian can use a terrain-aligned cone breath attack once per day. Each success deals 2 damage at no Mana cost.

races.name: Scion
races.notes: Eight approved elemental aspects; excludes Nature and Arcane. Display name Scion; legacy data id sion retained for compatibility. Aspect mechanics still pending.

lore.physiology: Elemental humanoids with recognizable humanoid forms composed of living elemental energy rather than ordinary flesh.
lore.aspectIdentity: Each Scion embodies one elemental force. Nature and Arcane have no Scion aspects.

aspects.name: Fire
aspects.bodyComposition: Living fire elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Living Flame
innateAbility.description: Produce light from the Scion's own fiery body at will. The light may be suppressed or restored voluntarily.

aspects.name: Water
aspects.bodyComposition: Living water elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Fluid Form
innateAbility.description: Temporarily reshape watery body to pass through narrow openings provided the entire body's volume can pass. Does not grant intangibility.
innateAbility.limitations: Opening must accommodate total body volume; cannot phase through solid barriers

aspects.name: Earth
aspects.bodyComposition: Living earth elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Burrow
innateAbility.description: Move through natural soil, sand, and loose earth at half the Scion's current base ground movement; increases when base movement increases. Earth closes behind the Scion without leaving usable tunnels.
innateAbility.restrictions: Cannot penetrate solid bedrock or magically reinforced surfaces; burrowing does not automatically negate attacks when entering or emerging.

aspects.name: Air
aspects.bodyComposition: Living air elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Windborne
innateAbility.description: Glide horizontally through the air while gradually descending. Cannot gain altitude from gliding alone.

aspects.name: Light
aspects.bodyComposition: Living light elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Revealing Radiance
innateAbility.description: Radiate bright light from the body, revealing ordinarily concealed creatures and objects within the illuminated area. Does not automatically expose invisible creatures or dispel magical concealment.
innateAbility.condition: Searching for hidden creatures or objects in darkness within the area illuminated by the Scion

aspects.name: Shadow
aspects.bodyComposition: Living shadow elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Shadowmeld
innateAbility.description: Blend into existing shadows, gaining a Stealth bonus while hiding in dim light or darkness. Does not grant invisibility or create magical darkness.
innateAbility.condition: Hiding in dim light or darkness

aspects.name: Lightning
aspects.bodyComposition: Living lightning elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Lightning Reflexes
innateAbility.description: Gain a +5 percentage point bonus to Dodge against attacks the Scion can perceive.
innateAbility.condition: Against attacks the Scion can perceive

aspects.name: Ice
aspects.bodyComposition: Living ice elemental energy in humanoid form

innateAbility.name: Frostwalk
innateAbility.description: Ignore ordinary movement penalties from natural snow and ice, and gain +10 percentage points to Acrobatics checks to maintain balance on slippery or frozen surfaces.
innateAbility.condition: Maintaining balance on slippery or frozen surfaces
innateAbility.movementBenefit: Ignore ordinary movement penalties from natural snow and ice
innateAbility.limitations: Does not negate magical immobilization or movement restrictions

sharedRacialAbilities.name: Elemental Bolt
sharedRacialAbilities.description: Once per day a Scion can unleash a single-target bolt of its own element, dealing 4 damage per success without Mana cost.

races.name: Anthozoans

abilities.name: Amphibious Breathing
abilities.description: Can naturally breathe both air and water.

abilities.name: Reinforced Coral
abilities.description: The Anthozoan's living coral body provides 5% Physical Resistance in addition to its existing 5% Water Resistance.
abilities.mechanicsStatus: approved; resistance rounding pending shared rules

abilities.name: Chest of the Deep
abilities.description: Summon a magical storage space that the Anthozoan can access to store and retrieve belongings.
abilities.capacity: Base weight limit pending; expanded through future racial talents
abilities.mechanicsStatus: approved concept, weight-based capacity and racial-talent expansion; base weight limit and summoning details pending
abilities.capacityProgression: Racial talents increase the chest's maximum stored weight; no automatic rank-based increase

races.notes: Approved coral-colony aquatic humanoid, +3 percentage points Endurance and Presence, 5% Water Resistance, air and water breathing, land movement 4, swim movement 6. Balance audit: Reinforced Coral natural protection and Chest of the Deep summonable magical storage approved as concepts; exact mechanics pending. Existing racial traits retained.

lore.origin: Born from the reefs of Mezoria
lore.biology: A sentient coral colony inhabiting a humanoid form

movementNotes: Human base movement is 5; Sylvan base movement is 6 (+1 due to taller stature). Movement units/action rules not yet finalized.
